page.overview:
Who is The Lupine Hunters?

The Lupine Hunters are a duo consisting of Shannon McLaughlin and Curtis Soracco, who hunt werewolves and target isolated vampires for their blood. They ran into The Crypt-Ticks in .

Shannon McLaughlin became a hunter after a werewolf pack murdered his family, leading to false murder charges and an extensive psychiatric evaluation. He subsequently dedicated his life to destroying werewolves. While discovering vampires, he learned that consuming their blood helps him resist the Delirium. He operates as an independent ghoul, hunting vampires for vitae to maintain his abilities.

Curtis Soracco joined McLaughlin after finding him wounded by a lone werewolf and helping him recover at a motel. Fascinated by the occult since childhood, Soracco joined the hunt and hides his secret desire to become a werewolf, remaining unaware that he is actually Kinfolk.

While their primary targets are werewolves, they also target lone vampires. McLaughlin destroys any vampire he encounters as quickly as possible and is nearly addicted to vitae; he will track a vampire back to their haven and stake as many slumbering Kindred as he can during the day. Soracco differs in his approach, offering to spare a lone vampire's unlife if they agree to Embrace him, though he will still stake them if he feels threatened.
